CrawlEngine with defaults batch scrapes like the free function

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(null);
        java.util.List<String> urls = java.util.List.of("https://example.com/page1", "https://example.com/page2");
        var result = Crawlberg.batchScrape(engine, urls);
        System.out.println(result.completedCount());
        System.out.println(result.totalCount());
    }
}
```
